灵能光环在为帝国提供多种多样的修正效果的同时，也能对友好或者敌对国家施加影响。我们如果想要扩大光环的范围，就需要通过与超主进一步调和来解锁£research£灵能光环增强科技。

打开虚境选项卡或者将鼠标悬停在正下方£interface£恒星系预览面板中的的光环图标上均可以查看灵能光环的效果。
texts.en:
Our colonies with psionic populations now have the ability to emit a Psionic Aura. This Aura is drawn from the Shroud Patron with which we currently have the highest Attunement.

Psionic Auras have varying effects on our own empire, and can also affect friendly or hostile empires. To expand our Aura into more systems, we will need to more fully attune to a Patron in order to unlock £research£ Psionic Aura Intensification technology.

To observe the effects of our Psionic Aura, open the Shroud tab or hover over the Aura icon on the bottom-center panel in £interface£ System View.
